name: @shotstack/schemas
description: Centralized OpenAPI schemas and TypeScript types for Shotstack API

scripts.compile:zod:cjs: tsc --declaration false --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2022 --outDir dist/zod --skipLibCheck dist/zod/zod.gen.ts && node -e "require('fs').renameSync('dist/zod/zod.gen.js','dist/zod/zod.gen.cjs')"
scripts.compile:zod:esm: tsc --declaration --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target ES2022 --outDir dist/zod --skipLibCheck dist/zod/zod.gen.ts
scripts.compile:zod: npm run compile:zod:cjs && npm run compile:zod:esm
scripts.build: npm run clean && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true})" && npm run bundle && npm run generate:types && npm run generate:zod && npm run fix:discriminator && npm run compile:zod && npm run copy:index
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run test

author: Shotstack
